text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":12,"unit":"cats","kind":"count","span":"12 siamese cats"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"ratio ... 2:1"},{"id":"q3","value":1,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"ratio ... 2:1"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"one ratio-unit = siamese cats divided by the siamese ratio share (2)"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q3"],"out":"s2","note":"house cats = one ratio-unit times the house-cat ratio share (1)"},{"op":"add","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"combined total = siamese cats plus house cats"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"combined number of cats sold"},"dismissed":[]}
